note: §J classification: avg -> UNSUPPORTED_OPERATION (NOT invalid). `delivery: direct` because the author's wire schema pins the aggregation enum, so such a proposal can never arrive THROUGH a provider call — the audited seam rejects it as a malformed turn (a technical outcome) long before parse. The harness therefore hands the raw proposal to the orchestrator directly, which is exactly the seam under test: how run_authoring maps an author outcome onto the §F axes. `unsupported != invalid` is the whole point: an average is a perfectly sensible request the v1 grammar simply does not carry, and reporting it as malformed would be a lie about the requester.
